goal: Formalize user-approved own dynamic mock backend, persistent storage and extensible external data adapters into a bounded PRD/checkpoint addendum.
scope: Read current accepted baseline and actual existing Node/SQLite backend. User confirms no external backend exists and wants own backend for dynamic mock data with documented storage and future gym-database integration.

Write formal approved addendum in product knowledge base: simulation scenarios and persistent data model; stable API/domain model; source adapters/mapping/import/version/idempotency/conflict and write ownership; practical first connector contract without pretending unknown external schemas are plug-and-play.

Define explicit demo identity/operator flow isolated from future official identity and real data; revise prior no-simulation interaction constraints as needed under latest user decision; do not call demo login real WeChat verification.

Specify runnable mini-program-to-own-backend path and distinguish mock-data issue from actual request-domain blocking. No assumption that adding mock rows solves domain checks. Identify local development versus hosted requirements, minimum dependencies and any security setting change requiring explicit confirmation.

Update PRD/AC/checkpoint plan as versioned addendum, separate demo-MVP acceptance from future official integration/device/venue evidence, keep old evidence intact; propose one first bounded developer task.
out_of_scope: No product source edits, live external DB connection, real data, cloud purchases/deployment or blanket universal connector implementation.
No waiting for unavailable gym backend as prerequisite to demo work; no unsupported promises of zero-effort connection to arbitrary database.
acceptance: APPROVED/REVISE/PAUSE decision written in formal docs with exact paths/hashes.
Concrete dynamic backend/storage/adapter/identity/transport acceptance and sequential implementation checkpoints; latest user intent preserved.
evidence_required: Decision doc, PRD/AC/checkpoint addendum paths and hashes; changed baseline clauses and rationale; recommended first dev task.
stop_conditions: Stop after document submission for commander review; do not dispatch developer directly.
